reviewed.reason: Imports subprocess for offline FFmpeg checks on synthetic media in private test scratch.
Uses the verified FFmpeg and fixed synthetic video and audio filters. Test callers supply a private fixture path and fixed duration. The argv runs without a shell and has a 30-second timeout.
Uses the verified FFmpeg with fixed arguments to inspect one grayscale frame from a synthetic render in private scratch. The command runs without a shell and has a 30-second timeout.

Uses the verified FFmpeg without a shell to inspect one RGB frame from a synthetic acceptance export in private scratch. The sample time is finite and bounded to the clip interval. A fixed table supplies the crop position and the process has a 30-second timeout.
Uses the verified FFmpeg with fixed argv to decode a synthetic render created in private scratch. The command runs without a shell, discards decoded output and has a 30-second timeout.
Imports subprocess for the reviewed worker child, bounded waits and process-group termination.

A fixed Python interpreter and worker module run without a shell. The child validates the UUID and fence from the claimed PostgreSQL task. The supervisor adds a path it allocated in private scratch to the inherited environment.
The beta worker sets its exclusively created private TemporaryDirectory as CLIPFORGE_DATA_DIR before importing main. The public and private beta HTTP entrypoints do not mount app.main.
Imports subprocess for the reviewed read-only ffprobe inspection and its timeout handling.

Launches the verified ffprobe binary without a shell and with fixed switches, the fixed MOV demuxer in beta, file/pipe protocols and a 30-second timeout. The worker supplies its private local input.mp4 path.

The internal launcher executes FFmpeg from the trusted resolver as a list. It requires an absolute regular executable without privilege flags or capabilities and arms Linux parent-death supervision before exec.
Imports subprocess for the reviewed FFmpeg launcher, dedicated process group and timing controls.

A fixed Python launcher receives the verified FFmpeg executable as argv. Clip times and stream indexes are validated or computed, presentation options are enumerated, and input, outputs and subtitle files are generated in private worker scratch. The beta FFmpeg build disables network protocols.
Imports subprocess to read the fixed Git reference tree for the Bandit scope comparison.

Runs the absolute Git executable without a shell, using only the verified repository path, fixed reference commit and fixed app and scripts path arguments. The timeout and the command status fail closed.
